name: Maiden 83 Acoustic
reference: Iron Maiden acoustic moments played on an electric: Prodigal Son (Killers, 1981; 'a mostly acoustic song') intro/strums, and acoustic-style arpeggios over the Piece of Mind era's clean sections (Revelations intro, To Tame a Land)
rig: Electric (humbuckers) -> Boss AC-3 acoustic simulator -> acoustic body IR, double-tracked: left = AC-3 Standard -> Martin dreadnought body, right = AC-3 Jumbo -> Gibson J-45 body, into a Birch-style plate and a wooden-room ambience. (Maiden's acoustic parts were real acoustics in the studio; this is the electric -> acoustic emulation of rigs/13 made stereo.)
notes: Piece of Mind itself has no documented acoustic guitar, so this is Maiden's acoustic sound in general, built on the rigs/13 two-stage method (AC-3 turns the magnetic pickup piezo-like, the body IR adds wood and mic). Improvement over rigs/13: a stereo 'double track' like Maiden's two-guitar arrangements, each side a different AC-3 mode and body (Standard + Martin left, Jumbo + J-45 right, 12% apart in pan) so strums sound like two acoustics, not one widened one. Humbucker -> piezo pre-EQ from rigs/13 on both AC-3 blocks, lighter on the Jumbo side. Dropped rigs/13's Diamond compressor and Micro Amp to stay within 2 NAM blocks. No chorus/wobble (none on Maiden's acoustics). Reverb is ON (SW9 doesn't reach this instance): echo slot = reverb only (delay_ms 0) with the Lexicon 480L Large Plate, plus 480L Small Wood Room as always-on room (acoustics tracked in a wooden room). Levels: rigs/13's AC-3 + Martin chain needed +24 dB out_db to reach its target (with the compressor in front); without the compressor +20 dB is a guess, trim after a live sweep. Best on the neck humbucker, picked lightly.

left.label: Boss AC-3 Acoustic Simulator, Standard mode, knobs noon
Acoustic body IR: Martin dreadnought (piezo -> mic)
Lexicon 480L Small Wood Room (acoustic tracking room)

right.label: Boss AC-3 Acoustic Simulator, Jumbo mode, knobs noon
Acoustic body IR: Gibson J-45 (piezo -> mic)
Lexicon 480L Small Wood Room (acoustic tracking room)

levels.method: DI loop through the DAW rig (bus Rig, after compressor + limiter), scene CCs as the FCB sends them
